title: The Office User system role cannot be edited (lock icon, eye only)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Office User row.
  2. Look at the Actions column.
  3. Click the eye icon.
custom_expected:
There is no pencil icon; only the eye icon.

A read-only Permission Summary opens for Office User.
evidence: UI: on the Roles list the Office User row shows a lock and only the eye (visibility) icon — no pencil; the eye opens the read-only Permission Summary (View Permissions). NOTE for dev: the direct /roles-permissions/{id}/edit URL still loads an editable form (FE route not guarded) — list-level gating is correct.
